english:
Grenade Kills grant additional Super Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1%|1.4%|1.6%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 1%|1.4%|1.6%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 3%|4.2%|4.8%
• T4 Minors, T3-T4 Elites, and higher: 5%|7%|8%
• Players: 1.5%|2.1%|2.4%

Bonus Super Energy gains from Grapple Melee Kills are reduced by 50%.

Kills can only trigger either Ashes to Assets or Hands-On, never both.

source.text:
On Grenade Kill:
Grants additional Super Energy. 
Baseline: T1 = 0.2% | T2 = 0.2% | T3 = 0.6% | T4 = 1%

Tier 1: 1% | 1.4% | 1.6%
Tier 2: 1% | 1.4% | 1.6%
Tier 3: 3% | 4.2% | 4.8%
Tier 4: 5% | 7% | 8%
Guardians: 1.5% | 2.1% | 2.4%

Cannot simultaneously benefit with Hands-On.
Grapple Melee Kills reduce the Super Energy by 50%.
